name: Yampa River — Duffy Mountain to East Cross Mountain
blurb: Quiet Class I–II floating through Juniper Canyon and the Maybell valley on Yampa River State Park sites.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Mileage: CPW Yampa River State Park river sections. CPW low-water advisory posted for Yampa River State Park (as of 6-23-2026); check CPW before launching.

putInAccess.sourceName: BLM National Recreation Site Points (FeatureServer/2), feature 83117
putInAccess.note: BLM National Recreation Site Points (FeatureServer/2), feature 83117 is the managing agency's own boating-facility point, 80 m from the USGS NHDPlus centreline. Access: Duffy Mountain access with boat ramp, vault toilet, parking (CPW). (CPW Yampa River State Park river sections, https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/yampa-river-state-park/yampa-river-state-park-river-sections). Imagery check 2026-10-26 (Esri World Imagery + USGS NHDPlus HR): Pin at the ramp head by the parking loop; a ramp path leads about 25 m to the water.
